description: A list unified with a tuple of null and a string converts its second element to a string
notes: hashicorp/hcl unifies the tuple's element types, the dynamic pseudo-type of null and string, to string, and converts the tuple to a list of strings, which needs an unsafe conversion because of the null (unifyTupleTypesToList in cty/convert/unify.go); it then unifies that with the list of numbers to a list of strings (unifyTuplesAsList). The spec unifies a list and a tuple to the tuple type, whose second element is a string. Either way the selected list's second element becomes the string "2".
